# mistershell_metric_config (Resource)

Binds configuration of an existing backend-owned object. Create captures originals and applies only configured fields; destroy restores those originals and never deletes the object. Removing a field restores and releases it. Import explicitly adopts current readable configuration. One binding per object/configuration surface. configuration fields: is_enabled, display_order, options (whole override object; {} clears overrides). ID is the catalog key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_metric_config" "health" {
  id = var.metric_key
  configuration = {
    is_enabled    = true
    display_order = 10
    options       = { warning_threshold = 80, critical_threshold = 95 }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) configuration fields: is_enabled, display_order, options (whole override object; {} clears overrides). ID is the catalog key.
- `id` (String) Existing object ID, stable catalog key, or local. This binding never creates the backend object.

### Read-Only

- `original_configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Original owned configuration retained in state for restoration. Do not edit; protect Terraform state.
